t.text: People tab: an organization, and a team

why.text: Draft for Jithin (23 Nov), build list items 3 and 4. Only what the sample world holds: owners by team, member counts by team (9 and 12, 21 in all), counts by project where the reader is a member (5 and 4), the ThinkLatent contact. No invented names. The page shell and menu are as built; only the tab's content is drawn.
